system.description:
Betray Yourself – Identity Crisis.

This special condition is treated as a Mental Condition.

A creature suffering from an Identity Crisis finds themselves to be their own enemy. Each turn they spend all of their actions attacking themselves with damaging jutsu, effects and abilities, treating each attack as a critical hit.

If one of their allies spends their Reaction talking to the creature with an Identity Crisis they can remake their saving throw at advantage.
system.summary: Spends every action attacking itself, each a critical hit; an ally's Reaction talking to it lets it remake its save at advantage.

rules.text: Run its turns as attacks on itself (each a critical hit). An ally's Reaction spent talking to it lets it remake the save at advantage.
